automation.hint: Runs a skill or a prompt in the background as you, on a schedule, after a business action or by hand; results go to your inbox, and the run history opens each run's conversation.
automation.started: Started; see the run history for the result
automation.cronHint: 5-field cron: minute hour day month weekday, at most every 5 minutes
automation.eventHint: Choose the action to listen to

writeModeHint.read_only: Read only: no write tools are offered.
writeModeHint.ask: Ask: a write stops and its approval card goes to your inbox; it goes on once you confirm it in the conversation.
writeModeHint.pre_approved: Pre-approved: the write tools ticked here run at once, other writes still wait for you; a change of permissions, a tool switched off or denied ends the approval.
writeModeHint.auto_review: Auto review: writes that need confirmation go to the review model first; tools set to "People only" and actions that always need your own confirmation wait for you.

automation.noTools: You have no write tools to pre-approve right now
automation.sharedHint: Everyone in the tenant sees it; it runs as you and only you can change it.

error.paused: The assistant is paused by the platform
error.owner_inactive: The owner was disabled or deleted
error.owner_forbidden: The owner lacks the permissions to run it
error.mode_unavailable: The write mode is not available now
error.profile_missing: The profile was gone; ran with the defaults
error.overlap: Skipped: the previous run had not ended yet

automation.staleHint: Pre-approvals that no longer hold must be ticked again with the current password
